items.name: Albania Open 2026
items.information: Welcome to the fourth official WCA competition in Albania! Be sure to check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlbaniaOpen2026#80477-for-new-competitors). **Registration is only possible online through this website. Check the [Register section](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlbaniaOpen2026/register) for details.**

items.name: Albanian Open 2018
items.information: First WCA competition in Albania. The competition will also be positioned as Albanian National Championship 2018. So fastest Albanian competitors per event will be honoured as national champions. Two weeks before the competition, registered competitors will be requested by email to confirm their participation. Registered competitors must reply at least three days before the competition, otherwise they may be removed from the competitor list. On-site registration is possible until 12:30pm in the venue.
